verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents per-credential scopes for its OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow, which is designed for server-to-server use without an end user. A credential can only reach the routes of the scopes granted to it, and the docs advise granting only what the integration uses. Credentials can be revoked from the Internet Banking credentials panel, so an agent can be given a least-privilege, revocable credential. Missing for 10: a documented catalog showing how granular the scopes are, scope editing (scopes are immutable after creation), evidence of programmatic or API-driven credential issuance, credential expiry/TTL controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
